en.install_desc: Install or update Canban on macOS and Linux, set up a headless server, and find answers to common questions.
en.install_intro: A native workbench on your desktop. Persistent agents on your server.
en.requirements_text: Install Git and your chosen agent CLI, and complete the agent’s authentication. Canban uses Herdr Core (hc) to run persistent terminal sessions and guides you through setup on first launch if it is missing.
en.desktop_text: Run this command to install or update the desktop app.
en.linux_text: Installs to ~/.local/opt/canban and adds an application launcher. GTK4 and GStreamer runtime libraries are required.
en.headless_text: Install the CLI and daemon without GTK4 or a desktop session. Connect from the desktop app over SSH or Tailscale. Install Git, Herdr Core, your agent CLI, and project dependencies on the server.
en.updates_text: Run the same installation command again to update an existing installation. The desktop app also provides an update action when a new version is available.

faq_items: What is Canban?

Canban is a native Kanban and terminal workbench for AI coding agents. It brings task specifications, agent discussions, progress, and code review together on cards, with workflows that organize development and delivery.
Which agents can I use?

Canban uses Herdr to run agents, so agents supported by Herdr are supported in Canban — including Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor CLI, and custom terminal agents. Install and authenticate your chosen agent CLI before using it in Canban.
Which operating systems are supported?

Canban is available for macOS 13.0 or later on Apple Silicon, and Linux on x86_64 and arm64. Linux desktops require GTK4 and GStreamer runtime libraries. Linux servers without a desktop can use headless mode.
How do I install or update Canban?

Use the installation command on this page to install or update Canban. Running agents also requires Git, your chosen agent CLI, and Herdr Core. Canban guides you through Herdr Core setup on first launch if it is missing. See the Changelog for release details.
Can I run agents on a remote server?

Yes. Install Canban in headless mode on a Linux server, then connect from the desktop app over SSH or Tailscale to manage remote tasks and terminals. Install your agent CLI and development dependencies on the remote machine.
Is Canban free?
Canban is free and open source under the Apache-2.0 license. Your chosen agents, model APIs, or other services may have separate costs.

faq_items: Canban 是什么？
Canban 是面向 AI 编程 Agent 的原生看板与终端工作台。它将任务说明、Agent 讨论、开发进度和代码审查集中在卡片中，并通过工作流组织开发与交付。
支持哪些 Agent？
Canban 使用 Herdr 运行 Agent，因此支持 Herdr 所支持的 Agent，例如 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Cursor CLI 和自定义终端 Agent。请先安装所需的 Agent CLI，并完成它自己的登录或 API 配置。
支持哪些操作系统？
Canban 提供 macOS 13.0 及以上 Apple Silicon 版本，以及 Linux x86_64 和 arm64 版本。Linux 桌面版需要 GTK4 和 GStreamer 运行库；无桌面的 Linux 服务器可以使用 Headless 模式。
如何安装和更新？
使用本页的安装命令即可安装或更新 Canban。运行 Agent 还需要 Git、相应的 Agent CLI 和 Herdr Core；首次启动时，Canban 会引导安装缺失的 Herdr Core。各版本改动可在版本更新页查看。
可以在远程服务器上运行 Agent 吗？
可以。在 Linux 服务器上安装 Headless 版本，再通过 SSH 或 Tailscale 从桌面端连接，即可管理远程任务和终端。Agent 及其开发依赖需要安装在执行任务的远程机器上。
Canban 免费吗？
Canban 是采用 Apache-2.0 许可证的免费开源软件。你使用的 Agent、模型 API 或其他服务可能另行收费。
